refreshspecial-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa [[Special:RefreshSpecial|cusboonaysiinta gacanta ee bogagga gaarka ah]] ee bogagga gaarka ah
refreshspecial-help:
Boggan gaarka ah wuxuu bixiyaa hab lagu cusboonaysiin karo bogagga gaarka ah gacanta.
Markaad doorato dhammaan bogagga aad rabto inaad cusboonaysiiso, guji badhanka "{{int:refreshspecial-button}}" ee hoose si aad u cusboonaysiiso bogagga gaarka ah ee la doortay.
'''Digniin:''' Cusboonaysiintu waxay qaadan kartaa waqti wiki-yada waaweyn.
refreshspecial-fail: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal bog oo gaar ah si loo cusboonaysiiyo.
refreshspecial-js-disabled: (Ma dooran kartid dhammaan bogagga marka JavaScript-ka uu naafo yahay)
refreshspecial-none-selected: Ma aadan dooran wax bogag gaar ah. Waxaa dib loogu celinayaa doorashada caadiga ah.
refreshspecial-no-page: Ma jiro bog gaar ah oo noocaas ah
refreshspecial-replica-lagged: Nuqulku wuu dib dhacay, waa la sugayaa...
refreshspecial-reconnecting: Xiriirku wuu fashilmay, dib ayaa loogu xirayaa 10 ilbiriqsi gudahood...
refreshspecial-total-display: Waxaa la cusboonaysiiyay $1 {{PLURAL:$1|bog|bogag}} oo wadartoodu tahay $2 {{PLURAL:$2|saf|safaf}} muddo ah $3 (muddada dhammaystiran ee socodsiinta qoraalku waa $4)
